tools.name: cortex_estimate_optimization
tools.description: Analyze an optimization problem for free — returns a machine-readable decision block: recommended mode/backend, estimated runtime, USDC price, benchmark evidence. Always call this before paying for cortex_optimize.

tools.name: cortex_optimize
tools.description: Solve a QUBO/Ising optimization problem (x402-paid, USDC on Base). Returns a job_id to poll with cortex_get_job. Prices per successful run: classical $0.05, hybrid $0.10, quantum $1.503 (exact price quoted by POST /v1/estimate before payment). Use mode=auto unless you specifically need quantum.

tools.name: cortex_get_job
tools.description: Poll an optimization job by id. Free — returns status, solution, objective, error.

tools.name: cortex_list_backends
tools.description: List solver backends (classical/hybrid/quantum) with live availability and verified flag. Free — check before choosing a mode.
